test_the_life_ahead_starts_at_todays_age:
area, _ = quad(ratio, age, math.inf)
    return area

area, _ = quad(ratio, age, math.inf)
    return area + age
test_a_flat_failure_rate_has_no_memory:
area, _ = quad(ratio, age, math.inf)
    return area

area, _ = quad(survival, 0, math.inf)
    return area - age
test_an_old_pump_does_not_underflow:
area, _ = quad(ratio, age, math.inf)
    return area

area, _ = quad(survival, age, math.inf)
    divisor = survival(age)
    return area / divisor if divisor > 0 else 0.0
